scope: Original PLY-3 in-place replacement with candidate that avoids retaining a workspace snapshot in the project import handler
candidate: Reads import settings from a snapshot only for non-project file types; project replacement decodes without storing that snapshot in the handler.
observation: GUI Split/Extract, Undo/Redo digest checks and project export completed. In-place import started but the monitored peak crossed the limit and the owned harness was stopped before import completion.
comparison: The prior complete-build baseline crossed at 4309491712 bytes; this candidate crossed at 4308000768 bytes. Single independent runs that hit the cap cannot establish a quantitative improvement.
limitations: This candidate was not adopted as a solution for the in-place resource gate.
No post-reopen geometry comparison was obtained and native comparison remains open.
The old project must remain available until replacement succeeds; this experiment does not characterize all references or allocations.
